content:
Zero-Point Field (ZPF) 

Both United States and Russian patents working on different ways but both patents claim net energy extraction from a pervasive field (ZPF EM fluctuations in US; gravitational field in RU).  #ufotwitter 

Key Similarities

Both claim net energy extraction from a pervasive field (ZPF EM fluctuations in US; gravitational field in RU).

Both involve electromagnetic interactions in a vacuum environment (dielectrics/resonators in US; crossed E/B fields and charge flow in RU).

Both aim for "clean"/exotic power sources with potential over-unity implications.

Field Targeted

US: Electromagnetic zero-point radiation (quantum vacuum fluctuations).
RU: Gravitational field (classical Earth gravity acting on spinning charges).

Mechanism

US: Passive resonance + beat-frequency interference from two slightly detuned resonators → down-conversion of ultra-high-freq ZPF.
RU: Active initial spin-up of charge cloud in magnetron → gravitational self-acceleration → feedback-stabilized microwave output. No beat frequency, no interference of secondary radiations.

Key Components

US: Dielectric structures, antenna, low-freq converter.
RU: Magnetron generator, rotating electron/ion cloud, feedback control, microwave load.

Output Type

US: Electrical energy via rectification.
RU: Microwave power (for heating or further conversion).

Physics Claim

US: Quantum vacuum EM energy harvesting.
RU: Gravitational torque/self-acceleration on rotating charges (macroscopic, no quantum vacuum or gravitons/waves claimed).

Status/Context

Both are fringe/unproven; no mainstream validation or replications. RU2252335C2 draws from older Soviet/Russian ideas on gravitational engines/flywheels, not linked to Leonov (whose patents like RU2184384C1 use quantized vacuum for longitudinal gravitational waves).
